request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0130]: a job is not valid
  cause  deadline_ms is 0; a job needs a deadline between 1 ms and 24 hours
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    set deadline_ms and submit the job again
  more   zcube explain E0130
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0130.html
